about_the_game:
Hunger Gods is a roguelike tower defense game, where your ultimate goal is to spread and defend the influence of the blood-thirsty God of your choice. Repel waves of vindictive humans to definitely re-instate your Master, and mold the World to its will.

Place and level up towers

Place your towers wisely, using the spots on the map to repel the enemies. Merge your towers up to level 3 to unlock special abilities to make your strategy even more powerful.

Link your towers to your advantage

Link towers between them to share their abilities, and strengthen all of your turrets. Use your links wisely to make them count!

Hone your strategy

Each enemies are particularly weak to specific towers. You’ll have to find the right strategy, balance the type of towers you use and their special abilities to refine your strategy and find your way to fight your way through the waves.

Enjoy a roguelike experience

Each run is different! The pool of towers at your disposal is randomized, as well as the bonuses you can get between waves or when upgrading your towers – you’ll have to be smarter than the game to beat it!
